oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: is_enabled looks up a camelCase key while the flags dict stores snake_case keys
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: lookup keys must exactly match stored keys for dictionary access to succeed
mechanism_steps: is_enabled constructs or receives a camelCase key
flags dict contains only snake_case keys
dict lookup does not find a matching key
default value (False) is returned
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: flag returns False even when the feature is enabled in configuration
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: the default False value appears intentional for disabled flags, masking that the lookup key never matches

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: nested config traversal uses an incorrect intermediate key in the path

mechanism_steps: is_analytics_enabled traverses nested configuration keys
an intermediate key does not match the actual config structure

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: environment variable lookup uses a key that does not match the actual variable name

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: commit and freeze_view steps are removed from process_batch as redundant
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: each pipeline stage encodes a distinct state transition required for downstream correctness
mechanism_steps: process_batch previously executed commit(st) to finalize state
commit sets frozen=True which downstream functions depend on
freeze_view rebuilds view from stable state for consistent reads
removing both steps eliminates required state transitions
downstream logic reads incomplete or inconsistent state
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: committed totals are incorrect and views are inconsistent with stable state
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: commit and stage appear redundant because both copy data, but commit establishes a frozen state required by downstream logic

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: cache invalidation is removed before setting a new value in update_record
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: ordering between invalidation and set operations is required for correct cache versioning
mechanism_steps: update_record invalidates cache which updates versioning state
update_record sets a new cache value based on version
removal of invalidation prevents version update
conditional cache set does not take effect
subsequent reads return stale cached data
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: cache does not reflect updated records and returns stale data
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: invalidating before setting appears redundant, masking that it drives version tracking required by the cache write

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: use_new_pricing parameter is not propagated to pricing.compute_price
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: control parameters must propagate through the full call chain to influence behavior
mechanism_steps: checkout accepts use_new_pricing parameter
checkout calls downstream functions without passing the parameter
pricing.compute_price reads a global flag instead of the parameter
pricing logic ignores the caller-provided value
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: pricing behavior does not change when use_new_pricing is set
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: passing the flag into checkout appears sufficient, masking that downstream functions ignore it
